title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Blissful Moment With You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, over here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shizuku♪
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're here early, Haruka.
Have you already begun stretching?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I came here right after homeroom ended.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Minori's doing animal caretaker committee stuff right now, so she's going to be a bit late.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me. Airi's also going to be a little late. She went over to the office to ask the teachers some questions.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, once we've finished stretching, why don't we get started with practice without them?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Oh, speaking of stretches...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The ones you taught me the other day for increasing my flexibility have been doing wonders.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only do they allow me to really get at the muscles I'm trying to stretch, they also help me relax.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They do? I also like those stretches because they feel so good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So good that I'll fall asleep sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even after the festival, your sister's staying up late each night to practice? I guess I shouldn't be surprised.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I feel like she should take a break, since she and the others just completed a very big challenge.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But based on what you just said...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You didn't suggest that she take one?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She always looks like she's having so much fun whenever she's practicing. To her, it probably doesn't feel like she's pushing herself at all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's just having so much fun that she doesn't want to do anything else.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Their debut song became a big hit, everyone has been talking about the song they made for that commercial, and they received a good response at that festival, after all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They really seem to have caught an enormous wave.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They made their dream come true and got the best start imaginable... And I'm sure they feel that they need to keep pushing the envelope.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I feel that I shouldn't ruin their streak by asking her to take a break...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Still...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If I were in her shoes, I wouldn't see it as much of an interruption.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You are family after all♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If anything, I'd feel really happy, since a family member is showing genuine concern for me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. You know her better than anyone, so I feel that you're in the perfect position to tell her this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, she's a pro now, so it's important for her to take breaks when she can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Given how professional and responsible she is, I think she'll be more than willing to hear you out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so worried about causing her trouble that I'd forgotten about that very important fact.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll try asking her later.
If possible, I'd like to gradually lead into the topic...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Or you could just invite her to do something with you straight out. Wouldn't that also work?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You'd also be able to secure some quality time with her that way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone! I really appreciate it!
